before.name: Job Garcia
before.description: Job Garcia is a photographer and doctoral candidate at Claremont Graduate University. Federal agents arrested him on June 19, 2025, while he recorded an immigration raid at a Hollywood Home Depot and warned people about their rights. He was taken to the Metropolitan Detention Center and released the following day without charges. His lawyers at MALDEF subsequently submitted an administrative claim alleging unlawful detention and retaliation for recording the agents.
